Kill [[Magmus]].

==Quest information==
===Objectives===
* Kill Magmus in the [[Heart of the Shiverpeaks]].
* *BONUS* Kill Magmus in [[Hard Mode]].
* See [[Zehnchu]] <nowiki>[</nowiki>[[Zaishen]] Challenge] for your reward.

===Reward===
* 10,000 [[Experience]]
* 1,500 [[Gold]]
* 2,500 [[Deldrimor rank|Dwarf reputation points]] 
* Complete the Base Objective for 40 [[Copper Zaishen Coin|Zaishen Copper Coins]].
* Complete the *BONUS* Objective for an additional 100 Zaishen Copper Coins.

==Walkthrough==
He appears in [[Heart of the Shiverpeaks]] on your [[character]]'s second trip through. Your character must have completed the [[Heart of the Shiverpeaks (quest)|Heart of the Shiverpeaks quest]] to reach Magmus. Make sure no one in your party has that quest active, or [[Cyndr the Mountain Heart]] will [[spawn]] instead.
